ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
<image>In $\odot G, m \angle A G B=30$ and $\overline{C G} \perp \overline{G D}$.
Find $m \widehat{C D F}$
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Geometry3K open-ended question

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a circle with G as the center, and A, B, C, D, F are all on the circle. It can be seen that A, G, D are on the same straight line, and B, G, F are also on the same straight line, therefore AD and BF are diameter directions passing through the center of the circle. The figure also marks radii from G to C and D, and there is a right angle mark between GC and GD. Reasoning: It is known that m∠AGB = 30°, and CG ⟂ GD, so m∠CGD = 90°. Because GA and GD are opposite rays, and GB and GF are opposite rays, ∠DGF and ∠AGB are vertical angles, therefore m∠DGF = 30°. Arc CDF is composed of arc CD and arc DF, and their corresponding central angles are ∠CGD and ∠DGF respectively, so m arc CDF = 90° + 30° = 120°.

The requested arc CDF is made of arc CD plus arc DF, whose central angles are ∠CGD and ∠DGF. Thus m arc CDF = 90 + 30 = 120.
